subject: MAP draft + target close / procurement signature deadline (OlivePay)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@olivepay.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft + next steps (OlivePay)

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the call earlier — it was great to walk through the integration priorities and performance needs. Per our discussion, I'm attaching a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lays out milestones, owners, and target dates so we can sync on procurement timing. High level:

- Target close: 2026-07-15 (pending procurement signature)
- Key milestones: Technical POC sign-off, Security questionnaire completion (SOC 2 evidence), Commercial review / SOW finalization, Procurement signature
- Dependencies: Your internal procurement board dates, legal redlines, and any additional security evidence requests

Action items in the draft:
- OlivePay: confirm procurement signature deadline and internal approvers (Procurement, Legal)
- Redwood: finalize SOW and provide SOC 2 artifacts by 2026-07-06
- Both: schedule POC validation week of 2026-07-06 if possible

Attachments: OlivePay_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), SOW_draft_OlivePay_v1.pdf (SOW draft)

Can you confirm if the 2026-07-15 signature date is feasible on your side? If not, share the latest procurement deadline and any blockers and we'll update the MAP.

Thanks — I'll loop in Aditya and Camila to track POC and integration owners.

Best,
Marissa
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Samir Patel <samir@olivepay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: OlivePay Procurement <procurement@olivepay.com>, Jia Wong <jia.wong@olivepay.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 16:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft + next steps (OlivePay)

Marissa —

Appreciate the recap and the MAP — this is very helpful. Quick update from procurement: our next procurement board is on 2026-07-12 and the procurement team needs contracts signed by end of day 2026-07-15 to include in the July billing cycle. Can you confirm Redwood can commit to providing final SOW + SOC 2 artifacts and respond to any redlines before 2026-07-10 so legal has time to review?

Also please list the owners for the POC validation (technical contact) and who will handle production onboarding post-signature. Procurement copied here (procurement@olivepay.com) will expect a revised MAP with responsibilities and a clear signature deadline.

Thanks,
Samir
Head of Integrations
OlivePay

Team —

Forwarding Samir's note: procurement needs final docs by 2026-07-10 (so legal can sign off ahead of 2026-07-12 board) and executed contracts on 2026-07-15. Can we commit to the following?

- Redwood deliverables:
  - Final SOW (incorporate any commercial comments) by 2026-07-06
  - SOC 2 evidence + answers to security questionnaire by 2026-07-06
  - POC support & validation week of 2026-07-06 (Aditya lead)
  - Post-signature onboarding plan and owner (Camila lead)

Aditya — can you confirm POC bandwidth and whether the week of 7/6 works for validation? If there are any likely legal redlines that will push beyond 7/10, flag them now so we can escalate.

Camila — once we confirm the dates, I'll update the MAP and send back to procurement + Samir.

Thanks,
Marissa

Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP draft + next steps (OlivePay) — procurement deadline

Marissa / Camila —

We can commit to the POC validation week of 2026-07-06. I'll block Aditya-eng@redwood.com and schedule 3 half-day sessions for integration verification and load testing. I don't anticipate blocking legal redlines for the SOW beyond standard indemnity/term edits; we should be able to get the final SOW to you by 2026-07-06 if commercial comments are minimal.

I recommend we also provide a short technical acceptance checklist (I'll draft) to speed sign-off after the POC. Camila — if you can prepare the onboarding timeline and capacity plan, I'll include the technical owners on the MAP.

Will follow up with calendar invites and the POC checklist by EOD.

Thanks,
Aditya
Principal Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
